issues.description: Method visibility mismatch for SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery(String,int,int): The problem statement's UML explicitly marks acceptSupplyDelivery as public ("+acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int): void"), but the solution implementation declares the method without an access modifier (package-private) as "static void acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity)". This discrepancy can confuse students about the intended API and may cause issues if tests or external callers expect a public static method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the implementation match the UML and problem description by declaring the method public and static: change the signature to "public static void acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity)". Alternatively, if package-private visibility was intentional, update the problem statement/UML to indicate package-private visibility so students are not misled.
